headline: One in three young Britons are still virgins, major Lancet study finds
label: VIRAL
caption:
Britain's young people are waiting longer than any generation before them 📉

One in three Britons aged 16 to 24 are still virgins, according to Natsal 4, Britain's biggest national survey on relationships and lifestyles, published in The Lancet. That is up from around one in five between 1990 and 2010.

The study surveyed about 6,700 people across England, Scotland and Wales between September 2022 and January 2024. Among under 25s, 38 percent of women and 28 percent of men said they had never been in a physical relationship.

Intimacy is falling among older adults too, with under 45s now reporting it about twice a month, half the rate recorded in 1990. Researchers point to more time spent online, young people living longer with their parents and a stronger focus on consent as possible reasons.
